coordinate_frame: X = body longitudinal axis (head toward +X), Y = wing span (butterfly's left = +Y), Z = vertical / print build direction. All STL files share this frame and the neutral pose.

parts.name: body
parts.role: fixed: head, eyes, antennae, thorax, abdomen, 2 pins with retaining caps

parts.name: left_wing
parts.role: moving: left wing (+Y side) with eye ring

parts.name: right_wing
parts.role: moving: right wing (-Y side) with eye ring

joints.name: left_wing_joint
joints.axis_note: rotation axis is the line through origin parallel to +Z; positive angle = right-hand rule about +Z (counter-clockwise seen from above)
joints.axial_retention: lower 45deg pin flange (D8) under the eye ring + upper 45deg cone cap (D15) over the eye ring; normal clearance 0.5 mm everywhere

joints.name: right_wing_joint
joints.axis_note: rotation axis is the line through origin parallel to +Z; positive angle = right-hand rule about +Z (counter-clockwise seen from above)
joints.axial_retention: lower 45deg pin flange (D8) under the eye ring + upper 45deg cone cap (D15) over the eye ring; normal clearance 0.5 mm everywhere

motion_validation: Rotate each child part about its joint axis by any angle in range_deg, with the other wing at any angle in its range (or held still); no part pair intersects (see verification_report.json).
